name: Lanterns
desc: Rows of festival paper lanterns strung on catenary wires across the upper frame, glowing warm and swinging on the wind so a slow wave travels down each row; hung in a band that leaves the rest of the frame open — warm ribbed paper, an electric festoon of Edison bulbs, a two-ink riso print, sumi silhouettes, or a schematic line drawing.

energy.doc: glow intensity and the amplitude of the swing/sway motion

scale.doc: lantern size — min a dense sprinkle of small lamps, max big paper globes

density.doc: how many strings (2 to 5) and how many lanterns hang on each

speed.doc: how fast the wind swings the lanterns

wind.doc: wind strength — wire sag, string drift and how far the lanterns swing

x.doc: centre of the band across frame

y.doc: height of the band — where the strings hang so the rest of the frame stays open

style.doc: aesthetic: warm ribbed paper lanterns lit from within / an electric festoon of little Edison bulbs / a two-ink riso print / sumi-black lantern silhouettes with no glow / a cyan schematic line drawing

seed.doc: hang lottery — per-lantern hue drift, flicker phase and swing lag

alpha.doc: layer opacity — scales every mark so it dissolves into the background rather than veiling it
